urn:skm:access:command:create-token:v1.title: CreateToken
urn:skm:access:command:create-token:v1.description: Issue an API token for the actor (principal_id null) or for another principal. Not idempotent: the secret is returned once and is never stored.

permission.description: One entry of the permission catalog (spec/00-conventions.md §5); membership in the catalog is checked by the domain, not by the schema.

token_kind.description: personal: human/service token; worker: token of a worker process (TTL access.tokens.worker_ttl_hours, rotated); assignment: runtime/MCP token of one assignment step (scope = run; .read permissions also cover the ancestors of the run, writes only the run and below; never worker.claim; carries assignment_id and step_id; expires with the lease).

urn:skm:access:result:create-token:v1.title: CreateTokenResult
urn:skm:access:result:create-token:v1.description: The only document that ever carries the token secret. Surfaces print it once and never log it.

urn:skm:artifacts:command:add-file:v1.title: AddFile
urn:skm:artifacts:command:add-file:v1.description: Create a logical file and its version 1 from a staged blob (SkmClient.upload_blob). Consumes the staged blob.

original_filename.description: G21: basename only (no '/', '\\'), not '.' or '..', no control or bidi characters; at most 255 UTF-8 bytes (checked by the domain: validate_filename, since JSON Schema counts code points).

declared_media_type.description: type/subtype (RFC 6838), lower-case, parameters stripped by the client; compared with the signature (CS-MEDIA-MISMATCH).

urn:skm:config:bootstrap:v1.title: Bootstrap configuration
urn:skm:config:bootstrap:v1.description: Minimal configuration read before the database: how to reach the state, which instance and host this process is, where local state lives. Everything else lives in the settings levels. Two shapes: a single instance (instance_id, access, database|api at the top) or named instance profiles ([instances.<name>] + default_instance, G17).

installation_id.description: Identity of the local installation shared by all named profiles.

machine_database.description: Installation-level database connection references, shared by all profiles.

url.description: DSN for the local machine application role.

migrator_url.description: Separate DSN used by local machine schema initialization.

default_instance.description: Profile used when neither --instance, SKM_INSTANCE nor the CLI context of the directory names one.

id.description: Single-instance shape only; with profiles every profile has its own host id (a host is registered per instance).

migrate_on_start.description: Local profile only (access.mode = embedded): skm serve applies pending migrations before the schema check; a server profile must keep false (K21).

migrator_url.description: Optional DSN of the migrator role (skm_migrator) for the local `skm db migrate`; absent → database.url. Never used by skm serve, workers or the API (migrations are not applied over HTTP).

pool_min_size.description: Connections the process pool keeps open.

pool_max_size.description: Upper bound of the process connection pool. Absent: the default of the surface (skm serve: api.threadpool.size + enabled background services + 3; skm worker: 2 * worker.capacity + 2; CLI/hook/MCP: 2), computed after the start-up connection read the process config (kernel-platform §5.3 step 6b). A value below that minimum refuses the start with CONFIG_INVALID.

pool_timeout_seconds.description: Wait for a free pool connection before a request fails with BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE (retryable).

ca_bundle.description: Path of a PEM bundle used to verify the server certificate.

token_pepper.description: Pepper of API token hashes (created by skm init). Required on the control plane.

web_auth.description: Pre-database HTTP web authentication configuration (ADR 0010 addendum).

mode.description: HTTP web admission mode: 'admin_login' requires Bearer or session cookie; 'none' permits loopback-only local owner access with proxy headers disabled.

forwarded_allow_ips.description: Trusted reverse-proxy peer IP addresses or CIDRs passed to Uvicorn forwarded_allow_ips in admin_login mode; ignored when mode is none.

session_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of a web session cookie in seconds.

cookie_samesite.description: SameSite attribute of the HttpOnly session cookie.

login_rate_limit_max.description: Maximum login or pairing exchange attempts per peer within login_rate_limit_window_seconds.

login_rate_limit_window_seconds.description: Sliding window in seconds for login and pairing exchange rate limiting.

paths.description: Local state of this host (G23). With instance profiles the effective state_dir of a profile is <state_dir>/instances/<name> unless the profile sets its own paths.

blobs_root.description: staging/ and <workspace_id>/objects/ of the local blob store; never cleaned by skm local clean.

materialized_root.description: Materialized file versions handed to steps.

urn:skm:config:entry:v1.title: Config entry
urn:skm:config:entry:v1.description: One stored contribution of a level: the view of a row of skm_config.entries.

value.description: Absent for op=unset. Secret keys hold a secret reference string.

label.description: Human label such as project:skm or plan:PLAN7 (output only).

urn:skm:config:explain:v1.title: Config explain report
urn:skm:config:explain:v1.description: Effective values of a scope with full provenance. Secret values never appear: secret keys show their reference.

urn:skm:config:frozen:v1.title: Frozen run configuration
urn:skm:config:frozen:v1.description: Snapshot of the run_frozen keys of the run scope taken by StartRun; stored in skm_execution.execution_bundles.config_snapshot.

registry_digest.description: Digest of the versioned registry descriptor: section schemas, defaults, merge/reload/normalization semantics, and enabled modules. Unknown descriptors fail closed before execution.

digest.description: SHA256 of canonical {schema, registry_digest, values}; binds values to their original interpretation.

values.description: key -> effective value; keys absent from the map were absent (nullable) at freeze time.

provenance.description: key -> label of the winning layer (default, pack:<id>, instance, workspace:<slug>, …).

urn:skm:config:key-spec:v1.title: x-skm key metadata
urn:skm:config:key-spec:v1.description: Metadata of one settings leaf (the value of its x-skm keyword) and of a section (x-skm-section). Read by platform/config/registry.py; ignored by the JSON Schema validator.

override.description: The invocation level (SKM__… env, --set, --config) may set the key.

lockable.description: An instance or workspace entry may lock the key for nearer levels.

nullable.description: The effective value may be absent (key without default and without contributions).

pack.description: Pack config fragments (level pack) may set the key.

path.description: String value is a filesystem path: ~ and ${state_dir} are expanded by the loader.

write_permission.description: Permission required in the target scope in addition to config.write / config.write_shared (for example hook.manage for hooks.subscriptions).

order.description: Enum values from the least to the most restrictive; narrow keeps the most restrictive.

unlimited.description: Value that means 'no limit' (0 for numbers, [] for lists); treated as +infinity / the full set.

id.description: Section id = first key segment; plugin sections are plugins.<plugin_id> (mechanisms/02-plugins §6).

urn:skm:config:secret-ref:v1.title: SecretRef
urn:skm:config:secret-ref:v1.description: Reference to a secret, never the secret itself. secret://env/NAME, secret://file/<absolute-or-~-path>, secret://keyring/<service>/<name>.

x-skm.intrinsic_retry: manifest_id + canonical validated body digest, checked after current owner guard

urn:skm:context:manifest:v1.title: ContextManifest
urn:skm:context:manifest:v1.description: Immutable record of the input of one agent step (spec/modules/context.md §5.13): every block with source, version, digest, tokens, trust and the reason of its inclusion or exclusion; route passport with what the runtime loads by itself (G13). state draft is written in phase A; final after context.finalize_manifest. Example: examples/context/context-manifest.json.

block_ref.description: d: control-plane block of the draft, c: conditional skill, x: excluded in phase A, h: host block (h:<request_id>).

atomic_group.description: Server-owned conflict group: all members are included or excluded together; absent means no group.

degraded.description: RouteDecision.degraded: capabilities the step runs without (runtimes.degraded.allow), e.g. config_isolation.

urn:skm:context:research-result:v1.title: ResearchResult
urn:skm:context:research-result:v1.description: Answer of one research source to one query (spec/modules/context.md §4.6, §5.14; P09.09, audit G3/G39). Retrieved text is data; claims and citations may only reference documents of this result; a source error is status error, never an empty ok.

kind.description: command | filesystem | mcp_stdio | key of a research_source plugin component.

output-manifest.description: New seals use skm-output-v2. tree_digest is SHA-256 typed path/tree identity payload per adapters §3.6; manifest_digest separately hashes this entire canonical JSON document. Raw byte order and SHA lengths are validated semantically.

staged-file.description: File staged by SkmClient.upload_blob; the server registers the file version after the fence (K8).

path_bytes.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of relative raw Git path bytes; display is not identity. Semantic validator rejects NUL, empty/dot/dotdot segments and noncanonical encoding.

anyOf.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of relative raw Git path bytes; display is not identity. Semantic validator rejects NUL, empty/dot/dotdot segments and noncanonical encoding.

changed-path.description: Authoritative Git path, raw byte identity, immutable fingerprint. Rename requires old_path and old_path_bytes; digest expands rename to delete+add.

git-commit-request.description: Immutable candidate publication envelope; server verifies accepted outputs, matching arrays, claim/slot generations and request digest before executing. Empty commit_shas only for before_sha=after_sha no-op.

effect-admission.description: Fresh git_commit/executing guard result, valid until min(lease,slot,server_now+5s). Writer binds exact effect/request/epoch and durably consumes this admission once. Cached response is not new authority.

urn:skm:execution:execution-history:v1.title: HistoryPage

facts.description: Builder output structure only. Not an independently emitted generic source payload; nodes/edges derive from each closed source event.

urn:skm:execution:execution-history:v1.description: Safe projection only, never raw event payload. Canonical response <=1MiB; semantic checks ensure seq<=through_seq, monotonic scan, stable cursor binding, current auth and bounded refs. Events-only builder; absent old facts mean partial/unavailable. No file content or audit bodies. Page semantic caps: <=1600 nodes, <=3200 edges, <=1MiB canonical bytes. Final next_after=null implies scanned_through_seq=through_seq. Each scanned source event has an entry with explicit coverage/reason_codes, including non-history/legacy events; no silent source gaps.

urn:skm:execution:fix-brief:v1.title: FixBrief
urn:skm:execution:fix-brief:v1.description: Normative execution contract; details and semantic validation: spec/modules/execution.md.

urn:skm:execution:pending-continuation:v.title: PendingContinuation
urn:skm:execution:pending-continuation:v.description: Server-private attempts.continuation application cursor, not a worker DTO or a new domain lifecycle. The whole canonical value is <=65536 bytes; SQL JSONB-text <=131072 bytes is only a defensive backstop. NULL is stored outside this schema and never authorizes inference or replay of legacy work. An advance cursor records unapplied trusted triggers; a stage cursor records an already-applied semantic RunStage. Selection effects and cursor replacement are atomic; consuming stage and creating StageRecord are atomic. Semantic validation requires distinct trigger source_event_id values, exact source ownership, equality with cause.source_event_id when supplied, and registered host stage/parameter contracts. Never store delivery input_digest, configuration snapshots/digests, manifests, reservations, tokens, secrets, raw command bodies or host locators in this cursor or its params.

triggers.description: Exact trusted trigger records in committed event order. Source event IDs must be distinct even when cause values differ; that projection uniqueness and stream ownership are semantic checks.

stage_type.description: Registered host StageHandler type from the pinned workflow, including supported plugin types. Control-plane stages run within apply_action and are never queued as a host continuation.

params.description: Normalized semantic parameters, validated against the pinned registered stage contract before persistence. The cursor byte cap applies recursively; transport fields, raw bodies, credentials and host locators are forbidden by semantic validation.

work_policies.description: New records require complete work_policies; null is historical diagnostic-only and cannot authorize execution.

urn:skm:execution:role-result:advisor:v1.description: Advice of the advisor role (profiles advisor, advisor-critic) or the plan audit (profile plan-auditor, mode plan_audit). Holding (held) is decided by code from needs_owner, category, computed gate categories and confidence (execution.md §5.10).

urn:skm:execution:role-result:executor:v.title: ExecutorResult
urn:skm:execution:role-result:executor:v.description: Stage report of the executor role (document kind stage-report for semantics.py drift and heal). changed_paths is the role's claim; the authoritative list is computed by Vcs (OutputManifest).

urn:skm:execution:role-result:registrar:.title: RegistrarResult
urn:skm:execution:role-result:registrar:.description: Commit message of an accepted output. The registrar is deterministic by default (subject from the task title); the LLM variant returns this document. Trailers are added by the integrate stage, never by the role.

urn:skm:execution:role-result:researcher.description: Researcher role result per context §5.14(10) and §17(12). Claims cite host-assigned document_ids from this step research batches; sources_used names batch source IDs. Execution validates membership; the role cannot invent source records.

urn:skm:execution:role-result:scout:v1.title: ScoutResult
urn:skm:execution:role-result:scout:v1.description: Context map produced by the read-only scout role; becomes the context_map block of the executor's context.

urn:skm:execution:role-result:triager:v1.title: TriagerResult
urn:skm:execution:role-result:triager:v1.description: Triage of review findings (document kind triage-result). Every finding of the review appears exactly once in confirmed or rejected (checked by the server: TRIAGE_INCOMPLETE). Rejected blocker/major findings with a reproduction are re-verified read-only (rule TR).

reconfiguration_ids.description: Only unique latest-effective record IDs per semantic key, ordered by their RunReconfigured stream_seq; not the unbounded full history. The fixed semantic allowlist has <=128 effective keys, checked at registry construction. Full provenance remains in append-only records/events.

urn:skm:kernel:defs:v1.title: Kernel definitions
urn:skm:kernel:defs:v1.description: Shared primitive definitions referenced by every module schema.

uuid.description: UUID (v7 for entities) in canonical lowercase form.

digest.description: Tagged SHA-256 digest (canonical JSON or bytes).

display-key.description: Human key such as PLAN7, P2.4/U1, D3, V2.

secret-ref.description: Reference to a secret, never the secret itself.

usd-micros.description: Money in millionths of a US dollar (no floats in digests).

urn:skm:kernel:error-catalog:v1.title: ErrorCatalog
urn:skm:kernel:error-catalog:v1.description: Catalog of every error code of SKM v2. The data document is schemas/kernel/data/error-codes.json; tools/gen.py turns it into skm/kernel/generated/error_codes.py and docs/reference/errors.md.

urn:skm:kernel:event-envelope:v1.title: EventEnvelope
urn:skm:kernel:event-envelope:v1.description: A stored domain event as delivered to subscribers, SSE clients and exports. Semantically a superset of legacy event/v1 (CloudEvents subset).

correlation_id.description: Root of the causal chain; inherited by every command and event caused by it.

causation_id.description: Request id of the producing command (RequestMeta.request_id); its own cause is preserved separately in parent_causation_id. Diagnostic context never grants authority.

parent_causation_id.description: Producing command's RequestMeta.causation_id: the parent event or command id, or null when absent. Older envelopes may omit this field and readers treat omission as null. Caller-supplied identifiers do not prove a causal edge or confer authority.

urn:skm:knowledge:graph-answer:v1.title: GraphAnswer
urn:skm:knowledge:graph-answer:v1.description: Normative knowledge contract; details and semantic validation: spec/modules/knowledge.md.

urn:skm:learning:activity-summary:v1.description: Normative learning contract; details and semantic validation: spec/modules/learning.md.

exposure_coverage.description: Server-derived completeness of final step manifests and audit/model source lineage; shared findings or unresolved lineage remain unknown, even with no lesson refs. Caller claims are not trusted.

urn:skm:planning:specification:v1.title: SpecificationDoc
urn:skm:planning:specification:v1.description: Specification of a plan: the canonical document of a draft and the payload of a published revision. References between entities use display keys; identity is the uuid 'id'. Numbers are integers only (canonical JSON v1 forbids floats).

uuid.description: Stable entity id (UUIDv7, lowercase). Optional in a draft: SaveDraft assigns it.

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (historical date without time).

item_key.description: Item display key, e.g. P1.2; the prefix is its phase key.

unit_key.description: Unit display key, e.g. P1.2/U1; the prefix is its item key.

unit_ref.description: Unit reference: local U<k> (inside the owning item) or full P<n>.<m>/U<k>.

check_local_key.description: Check key unique within its owner (phase or item).

check_ref.description: Check reference: V<n> (owner implied by context) or <owner key>:V<n>.

entity_ref.description: Reference to a phase, item, unit, decision, requirement or criterion of this plan.

mount.description: Repository mount name of the project (project_repositories.mount_name).

repo_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path; no leading '/', '~', drive letter or '..' segment.

path_glob.description: Repository-relative POSIX path or fnmatch glob (*, ?, [..]); a trailing '/' names a directory.

plan_ref.description: Another plan of the same project: short alias <prefix><n> (prefix from planning.aliases.prefix, default PLAN; never AC) or plan:<uuid>.

section.description: Named content section; ids unique within the owning entity.

scope.description: Scope in words: what is in and out.

effort.description: Ordered low < medium < high < xhigh < max (legacy 'ultra' is imported as 'max').

runtime.description: Preferred runtime id (validated against the catalog; a preference, never a requirement).

correction.description: Minimum route of a bounded correction round.

route.description: Minimum semantic route of the work.

review.description: Explicit review contract. Absence of the field is not a waiver.

research.description: Research need (status is execution state, not specification).

read.description: One input to read, in reading order.

change_hint.description: Files likely to change (a hint, not a write limit).

write_scope_entry.description: Declared write scope entry of a unit (a limit enforced by the worker fence).

artifact_decl.description: Artifact consumed or produced; an output with a key may be read as artifact/<key>.

check.description: Verification of work: command, shell, manual or external.

owner.description: Phase or item that owns the check.

category.description: acceptance must pass for done; impact is a wider guard; live runs at a live boundary.

required.description: Default: true for acceptance, false otherwise (resolved by from_document, stored explicitly).

owner.description: Phase or item that owns the check.

category.description: acceptance must pass for done; impact is a wider guard; live runs at a live boundary.

required.description: Default: true for acceptance, false otherwise (resolved by from_document, stored explicitly).

unit_command.description: Exact command of a command unit.

brief.description: Owner brief: what was asked, by whom, in which words.

batch.description: Ordered execution group inside a phase; an item is in at most one batch.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite phases. Absent: the previous phase in order. Empty: none.

checks.description: Checks of the owning item that gate this unit.

material.description: Material bound to the revision: a pinned file version, a repository path or an external source. Freshness defaults to pinned (written explicitly by normalization).

required_for.description: Stages that cannot proceed without this material (empty or absent: optional reference). execution: blocks task start; review: blocks review rounds; acceptance: blocks the acceptance decision. Unavailable at that stage -> execution waits with BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL.

oneOf.description: Use exactly the pinned version (file_version), the run baseline commit (repository_path) or the captured content (external_source).
At publication the newest ready version of the same file is pinned and written into the revision; afterwards behaves as pinned.
Pinned, but older than max_age_seconds (file version created_at / retrieved_at) counts as stale: a stage it is required for waits with BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL until a revision pins a fresher one.

freshness.description: Use exactly the pinned version (file_version), the run baseline commit (repository_path) or the captured content (external_source).
